source_observation: iOS293 directory VM owns openFileHandler. Chat attachments already have a verified native QuickLook adapter for image/PDF and unsupported states. Official Remote-to-preview owner remains unknown.
host_gap: Remote preview interface returns UTF-8 String and directory metadata is projected into a diff record. This prevents binary resource previews.
decision: Use a scope-bound full-file byte resource provider for both directory and diff entry points. Retain existing text snapshots and resource ownership, accept file ID directly, and exercise native image/PDF/document preview.
independent_adaptations: Binary resource envelope and scoped synthetic provider
Generated PNG/PDF/RTF vectors and unsupported/missing file records
QuickLook capability check and failure metadata
unknowns: Official Remote preview controller and resource service wiring
Exact file row glyphs, layout and wide-screen navigation

validation.formats_ui: r2 Chinese light and English dark passed
validation.r1_failure: QuickLook overlay controls became hidden after image content loaded. Test now waits for native image canvas and reveals controls through its existing tap interaction. Product code unchanged.
validation.visual: Inspected PNG before/after pinch, two-page PDF before/after scroll, RTF light/dark and unsupported/missing directory feedback.
validation.shared_regression: r3 five cases passed; Chinese/English directory and diff recovery, missing resource, dismissal, retry, cancel and restart

resource_contract.request: scope(hostID, threadID), fileID and request UUID
resource_contract.snapshot: Changes menu captures latest-turn file snapshot at entry. Directory metadata contains no content payload.
resource_contract.ownership: Unique temporary file released after preview dismissal; invalid filename and failed write retain no temporary directory.
resource_contract.boundary: Synthetic provider is replaceable. Official Remote preview controller and server contract remain unresolved.
